criteria.description: On each request for a given IP, timestamps older than the 60-second window must be removed from the in-memory store before the request count is checked against MAX_REQUESTS.
criteria.evidence: rateLimiter.ts line 22: `const timestamps = (store.get(ip) ?? []).filter(t => t > now - WINDOW_MS);` — the filter runs inline per request and the result stored in `timestamps` is what line 24 (`if (timestamps.length >= MAX_REQUESTS)`) checks. No background setInterval is present in the file.

criteria.description: The Retry-After header must reflect the actual seconds until the oldest in-window timestamp expires, not a hardcoded constant.
criteria.evidence: rateLimiter.ts line 25: `const retryAfter = Math.ceil((timestamps[0] + WINDOW_MS - now) / 1000);` — uses `timestamps[0]` (oldest remaining after pruning) and `WINDOW_MS`. The literal `60` does not appear as the argument to `RateLimitError`; line 26 passes the computed `retryAfter`.
